description: This Java source file defines the ShippingProviderRegistry class, which acts as a central registry and dispatcher for shipping rate providers within a shipping service module. It manages a list of provider implementations, initializes them, and aggregates shipping rate quotes from all providers for a given request, handling exceptions gracefully.

classes.name: ShippingProviderRegistry
classes.description: A singleton component that maintains a list of shipping rate providers and facilitates obtaining combined shipping quotes while handling provider-specific failures.

methods.name: ShippingProviderRegistry
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the registry with a list of available shipping rate providers and logs their provider codes.

methods.name: quoteAll
methods.description: Aggregates shipping quotes from all registered providers for a given shipping request, sorts the results by amount, and returns the combined list.
